name: reright
description: Hosted MCP server that rewrites agent-drafted text for people so it reads human-written. rewrite sends draft text to reright.it and uses monthly words; rewrite_result and keep_original only act on drafts already sent. Guard contribution off by default; disconnect the MCP server to stop calls.
saferAlternatives: Leave the server off and use the agent's draft as written instead of sending it to reright.
Use rewrite_result to read a draft already sent. Use keep_original when an unchecked rewrite changes a fact; quote the phrases. Reject pending rewrites in review. Neither sends new text.
